desc: Ideate the solution approach (BFS on state space (pos_A, pos_B)).
Analyze complexity and confirm standard BFS is viable due to graph density vs. path length trade-off.
Implement the BFS solution in Python, reading input from stdin, building the adjacency list, and running the BFS to find the minimum operations or determine impossibility.
Run the code against Sample 1, Sample 2, and Sample 3 to verify correctness.
Check edge cases: Graph is a simple path (should output -1), Graph is a star graph, $S$ and $T$ are adjacent.
Ensure no memory limit exceeded errors on large inputs.
